---
title: "Methods and sources"
---

mortensor implements published methods. This page lists, for every method
of the package, its source and how the implementation relates to it:

* **published**: the method as published (numerical safeguards aside);
* **published, deviations**: the published method with stated changes;
* **package-specific**: no published source is known to us; the help page
  says so. Package-specific methods are never the default unless stated
  here, and deprecated ones warn when used.

The help page of each function gives the details and the full references.
Corrections are welcome: a published source for a method listed as
package-specific, or a deviation that is not listed.

## Data and harmonisation

| Function, option | Method | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mt_as_exposure()` | exposures from populations at 1 January, 31 December or mid-year | standard demographic approximations; HMD Methods Protocol for cohort formulas | published |
| `mt_data()` | deaths of unknown age distributed in proportion | HMD Methods Protocol | published |
| `mt_fill_suppressed()` | iterative proportional fitting to known totals | Deming and Stephan (1940); Bishop, Fienberg and Holland (1975) | published, deviations: bounds of suppressed cells enforced by clipping within each step (package-specific); cells without a total get the truncated-Poisson mean |
| `mt_ungroup(method = "pclm")` (default) | penalised composite link model with exposures, 1D and 2D | Rizzi, Gampe and Eilers (2015); Rizzi et al. (2019); code structure of the ungroup package | published, deviations: open age interval split with stationary-population weights (package-specific); `preserve_totals = TRUE` rescales to group totals (package-specific, opt-in) |
| `mt_ungroup(method = "monotone")` | monotone cubic interpolation of cumulative counts | Hyman (1983) | published |
| `mt_ungroup(method = "hyman_kannisto", "natural_gompertz", "gam")` | spline heuristics | none | package-specific, deprecated |
| `mt_smooth(method = "pspline")` | Poisson P-splines over age, or age and time | Eilers and Marx (1996); Currie, Durban and Eilers (2004) | published |
| `mt_smooth(method = "whittaker")` | weighted Whittaker smoother, smoothing parameter by GCV | Whittaker (1923); Eilers (2003) | published |
| `mt_smooth(method = "gam")` | quasi-Poisson GAM with exposure offset, `te(age, year)` in 2D | Wood (2017) | published |
| `step_shocks()` | shock years removed or interpolated before fitting | none | package-specific (interpolated years enter as data) |
| `life_table()` | q from m with a_x, open interval L = l/m | Preston, Heuveline and Guillot (2001) | published; a_x = n/2 by default |
| `life_table(open = "gompertz", "kannisto")` | closure of the open interval | Thatcher, Kannisto and Vaupel (1998) | published, deviations: least squares on the last ages instead of maximum likelihood |

## Models

| Function, option | Method | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lee_carter()` | Poisson or SVD Lee-Carter; adjustment of k; period choice | Lee and Carter (1992); Brouhns, Denuit and Vermunt (2002); Booth, Maindonald and Smith (2002); Lee and Miller (2001) | published; ridge and SVD fallbacks for sparse data are package-specific safeguards and warn |
| `lee_carter(rotate = TRUE)` | rotation of the age pattern of decline | Li, Lee and Gerland (2013); Ševčíková et al. (2016) | published, deviations: life expectancy path from the unrotated draws |
| `lee_carter(bootstrap = TRUE)`, `bootstrapped()` | parametric bootstrap of deaths | Brouhns, Denuit and Van Keilegom (2005) (observed deaths, `type = "data"`); Renshaw and Haberman (2008) (fitted deaths, `type = "grid"`) | published; refitting preprocessing in each replicate is package-specific |
| `rwd()` | random walk with drift per age | standard benchmark | published |
| `rwd(observation_noise = TRUE)` | moment estimator of a local level model | none (the model is ARIMA(0,1,1) with drift; Harvey 1989) | package-specific, deprecated: use `arima_series()` |
| `arima_series()`, `ets_series()` | ARIMA or exponential smoothing per age | Hyndman and Khandakar (2008) | published |
| `hyndman_ullah()` | functional demographic model | Hyndman and Ullah (2007), via demography | published |
| `coherent_fdm()` | product-ratio method | Hyndman, Booth and Yasmeen (2013), via demography | published |
| `product_ratio()` | product-ratio with Lee-Carter components | none | package-specific, deprecated: use `coherent_fdm()` |
| `li_lee()` | augmented common factor model | Li and Lee (2005) | published, deviations: AR(1) without intercept, clamped at 0.99 (warns) |
| `coda()` | compositional Lee-Carter of life-table deaths, coherent version | Oeppen (2008); Bergeron-Boucher et al. (2017); MortalityForecast | published, deviations: open interval regressed on the indexes |
| `coda_causes()` | multiple-decrement CoDa for causes | Oeppen (2008), abstract only | package reading of a published idea; experimental |
| `tucker3()` | three-way Lee-Carter by Tucker3 decomposition | Russolillo, Giordano and Haberman (2011); De Lathauwer et al. (2000) | published, deviations: HOOI estimation, forecasts of the period factors and rank choice are the package's; experimental |
| `cause_shares()` | Tucker model of log-ratio cause shares | none | package-specific, deprecated: use `reconciled()` or `coda_causes()` |
| `stmomo()` | GAPC models LC, CBD, APC, RH, M6, M7, M8 | Villegas, Kaishev and Millossovich (2018); Cairns et al. (2009) | published (StMoMo) |
| `stanmomo()` | Bayesian GAPC models | Barigou et al. (2023), via StanMoMo | published |
| `apc_bayes()` | Bayesian APC with random-walk priors | Schmid and Held (2007), via bamp | published |
| `mt_order_strata()` | keeps an ordering between strata path by path | none | package-specific |
| predictive draws (`mt_forecast(predictive = TRUE)`, backtests) | Poisson deaths given the model's rates; posterior negative binomial for `stanmomo(family = "nb")` | Brouhns, Denuit and Vermunt (2002) | published |

## Combining models and coherence

| Function, option | Method | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ensemble()` | mixture (linear pool) of predictive distributions | Gneiting and Ranjan (2013) | published |
| `ensemble(weights = "crps")` | weights inverse to the inner-backtest CRPS | analogous to Bates and Granger (1969) | package-specific |
| `ensemble(weights = "stack")` | stacking of point forecasts, used as mixture weights | Breiman (1996); Kessy et al. (2022) | published, deviations: weights optimise the medians, used for the mixture |
| `ensemble(top_k = )` | trimming to the best components | | package-specific |
| `reconciled()`, `mt_reconcile()` bottom-up, OLS, structural, WLS, MinT | projection of draws onto coherent forecasts | Hyndman et al. (2011); Athanasopoulos et al. (2017); Hyndman, Lee and Wang (2016); Wickramasuriya et al. (2019); Panagiotelis et al. (2023) | published, deviations: weights from the base draws' own variances instead of in-sample residuals |
| non-negativity | negatives held at zero, the rest projected again | related to Wickramasuriya, Turlach and Hyndman (2020) | package-specific heuristic |
| `fixed =` | immutable nodes | Zhang et al. (2023) | published, approximated by near-zero variance |
| `method = "proportional"` | top-down by forecast proportions | Gross and Sohl (1990); Athanasopoulos, Ahmed and Hyndman (2009) | published |
| `method = "energy_score"` | score-optimal reconciliation | Panagiotelis et al. (2023); ProbReco | published, deviations: per age, observation noise in training, rescaling |
| `dependence = "empirical"` | reordering of separately simulated strata | related to the Schaake shuffle (Clark et al. 2004) | package-specific, opt-in (default `"none"`) |
| `recalibrated()` | spread of the draws rescaled to minimise the CRPS of inner forecasts | member-by-member post-processing (Van Schaeybroeck and Vannitsem 2015); EMOS (Gneiting et al. 2005) | published, deviations: one factor for all horizons by default; power law over horizons, drift correction, age bands and life-expectancy targets are package-specific |
| `anchored()` | jump-off at the observed rates of the last year | Lee and Miller (2001) | published by default; averaging over years, linear decay and shrinkage are package-specific options |
| `tuned()`, `mt_tune()` | choice of settings by rolling-origin or hold-out accuracy | Tashman (2000) | published; one-SE rule approximate; two-stage grid package-specific |
| `stratified()` | different models for groups of strata | | package-specific plumbing |

## Evaluation

| Function, option | Method | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mt_backtest()` | rolling-origin evaluation | Tashman (2000) | published |
| CRPS from draws | empirical-CDF estimator | Gneiting and Raftery (2007); Grimit et al. (2006) | published |
| WIS | weighted interval score | Bracher et al. (2021) | published |
| PIT | randomised for counts | Czado, Gneiting and Held (2009) | published |
| MASE | scaled by in-sample naive errors | Hyndman and Koehler (2006) | published |
| `mt_dm_test()` | Diebold-Mariano test with fixed-smoothing (EWC) variance (default); HLN correction for `varestimator = "acf"` | Diebold and Mariano (1995); Harvey, Leybourne and Newbold (1997); Lazarus et al. (2018); Coroneo and Iacone (2020) | published |

## Results and derived quantities

| Function, option | Method | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `life_expectancy()`, `prob_dying()` | period life table | Preston, Heuveline and Guillot (2001) | published |
| `asr()` | direct standardisation on the standard's age groups | Eurostat (2013) | published |
| `yll()` | period-expected years of life lost | Murray (1994) | published |
| `mt_contrast()`, `mt_inequality()` | gaps, ratios, SII and RII | Mackenbach and Kunst (1997); Moreno-Betancur et al. (2015) | published |
| `mt_observed()` | Poisson bootstrap of observed indicators | | package-specific construction (parametric bootstrap) |
| `lifespan_variation()` | e-dagger, entropy, Gini, sd, IQR | LifeIneq; Vaupel (1986); Shkolnikov et al. (2003) | published, deviations: variance from the conditioning age; IQR by interpolation |
| `mt_decompose()` Arriaga, Horiuchi, stepwise, Kitagawa, radix composition | decomposition of differences | Arriaga (1984); Horiuchi, Wilmoth and Pletcher (2008); Andreev, Shkolnikov and Begun (2002); Kitagawa (1955); Riffe et al. (2024) | published |
| `mt_decompose(composition = "pooled")` | composition of areas by the line integral | | package-specific parametrisation |
| `mt_excess()` | observed minus predictive deaths of a baseline model | Msemburi et al. (2023) and others compare with expected deaths of a baseline | published idea; estimand and P-score draws as documented |
